Read the [endpoint guides](/reference/http/) for dispatch behavior.

Type notation: `Option<T>` can be absent/null; `Vec<T>` is an array; maps are JSON objects; `Value` and `SchemaJson` retain JSON. `rename` determines wire names, `flatten` adds properties at the containing level, `tag`/`untagged` control enum encoding, `default` permits omission, and `skip_serializing_if` affects output. Container attributes apply to every field. Semantic constraints are enforced separately by handlers and providers.

/// A forward-compatible Responses input or output item.
///
/// Keeping the discriminant optional also supports the API's "easy input
/// message" shape, where `{role, content}` is accepted without `type: message`.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq)]
pub struct ResponseItem {
    #[serde(rename = "type", skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub item_type: Option<String>,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub id: Option<String>,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]

    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub role: Option<String>,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub content: Option<ResponseContent>,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub call_id: Option<String>,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub name: Option<String>,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub arguments: Option<String>,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub output: Option<Value>,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub summary: Option<Vec<Value>>,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
